messages:
reza: Heads-up — last night's model-sync cron had ~40% failures across shards. Logs show bursts of S3 503s and a backoff loop that seems to saturate the worker pool, leaving many shards pending.
olivia: saw the alert this morning :eyes: which job id? can you paste a snippet of the error?
sam: grabbing logs now, linking: https://internal-logs/redwood/model-sync/2113156789 — lots of 503s + repeated immediate retries.
reza: exact error: `GetObject 503 SlowDown` and we have retry code that sleeps but doesn't add jitter or per-shard isolation, so one hotspot cascades.
infra-bot: cron-run notice: model-sync@0200 triggered, job=ms-4467, status=PARTIAL_SUCCESS (failed shards: 7/18)
jon: can we do a quick rerun for just the failed shards? prefer not to re-run everything and risk hammering S3 again.
olivia: +1. re-run failed shards only. sam, do you have a command we can use to requeue specific shards?
sam: you can hit the internal cron API: `POST /internal/cron/rerun` with body `{ "job": "model-sync", "shards": [3,7,12] }` — or from CLI:
```
redwoodctl cron rerun model-sync --shards=3,7,12 --env=prod
```
reza: I'll open a quick PR to add backoff jitter and per-shard exponential retry (so one bad shard won't stall others). Will aim to canary tonight.
olivia: for immediate mitigation, can infra throttle parallelism so only 4 parallel workers run at a time? that should reduce S3 pressure.
jon: safe short-term: reduce concurrency to 4 and add a 500-1500ms jitter between retries. infra, can you apply that to the scheduled job?
infra-bot: request acknowledged. created ticket INF-9312 to change concurrency and add temporary retry-window. ETA 2h.
sam: I've manually rerun the 7 failed shards via `redwoodctl` — started at 2113157200. Monitoring logs now.
reza: thanks. I'll post the PR link once opened and add an opt-in canary flag so nightly isn't affected until we've validated.
olivia: ping me on the PR, will review quickly. also let's add a short blurb to runbook about S3 hotspots and rerun steps.
jon: note for postmortem: classify this as "infra rate-limit + retry heuristic" not model logic.
reza: agreed. assigning follow-ups: reza -> PR for jitter/retry, infra -> concurrency change (INF-9312), sam -> validate reruns. I'll update thread when canary passes or fails.
olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: logs look green so far for rerun shards at 2113157350, will keep watching.
reza: good progress. closing triage here, will DM infra if we need emergency rollback.
_meta: generated for dataset: slack eng-ml cron model-sync rate-limit backoff triage
